t: This is 18 and 19 Fleet Street, in the EC4Y part of the City of London. It was designed by Arthur Blomfield, an English architect and keen church builder. He was president of the Architectural Association from 1861 and a vice-president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He became architect to the Bank of England, built its Law Courts branch in 1883, and was knighted. In 1891 he received the RIBA gold medal. I don't have more detail on this particular building.
